title: One Perfect Crop
objective: Finish One Perfect Crop from its frozen route/prose and resolved reuse research through durable art intake/production, implementation-exact combat and content-admin packets, final build freeze, Fable manifest implementation, exact-SHA independent review, and user-owned Forge execution/readback. This roadmap coordinates the remaining work; it does not replace the event's canonical prose, captures, art spec, content references, or user rulings.
notes: Audited from live main at daa91ab93d0a2ac48640739bcd4572736464fbcc. The older finish plan still says the Road Bandit probe is pending, but state/one_perfect_crop_bandit_resolution.md plus harvests/inbox/tnr_results_1789124514980.json prove that probe is complete and supersede that stale next-step note.

The accepted Ittetsu, Waystation Keeper and quest-icon bytes are described as accepted in the finish plan but are not present in the repository. Their intake remains BLOCKED until the exact bytes become durable.

The four background families are already locked for reuse in the finish plan. art.backgrounds is therefore an assessment/wiring task first; it produces new art only if the locked set genuinely fails and the user directs a new background.
Image-generation classes stay separated: SCENE_CHARACTER, AI_AVATAR, ICON, and any exceptional SCENE_BACKGROUND production run in separate clean contexts.

User-owned balance, rewards, item economics, repeatability and eligibility are collected in one executable director-decision packet. The Farming level 15 requirement must not be silently translated to character minLevel 15.

Session gates (docs/workflows/CONTENT_WORKSTREAM.md section 4b) were added to the art tasks after the failed Road Bandit generation proved that repository READY is not generation-ready. The initializer prints them as ACTION READINESS; generation_preflight.py renders the contract; the durable transfer bundle under art/style_ref_bundles/ carries the exact reference bytes. None of them changes the frozen prose, graph, combat spec, admin decisions or the global art spec.
